title: Use the code review to rebalance supermarket buying power
action: In the scheduled review of the remade Food and Grocery Code, consult on and adopt the ACCC's recommendations to balance supermarket buying power with suppliers, especially fresh food producers.
why: Suppliers with few alternatives to the two major chains face terms that shift risk onto them, weakening their incentive to invest.

evidence.source: Cracking down on the supermarkets to get a better deal for Australians (media release, 21 March 2025)
evidence.quote: Balancing supermarket buying power with suppliers, especially farmers and producers supplying fresh food, including further changes to the Food and Grocery Code. The Government will consult on these recommendations as part of the review of the remade code within the next 18 months.
